issues.on_page: Other taxes 450,133 (Statement of Activities); fund statement p4: Inheritance Tax Fund Taxes 435,285
issues.issue: Inheritance Tax Fund taxes of 435,285 cannot be in Property tax 5,914,827, so they sit inside 'Other taxes'. The inheritance tax / other taxes split would be 435,285 + 14,848. The report's detail already records the 435,285 as inheritance tax (detail[58]). The line is kept under its printed 'Other taxes' label, which is defensible under the rule that a printed label beats a fund name. The user should decide whether to split it.

The broad 'Local' line is in other. The Statement of Activities (p2) prints charges for services of 917,028, which may be most of it, but the page does not prove the mapping. Detail 'Local' lines are in other too (Communications Center 605,452, Emergency Mgmt 156,126, ARPA 58,001, etc.). This is a context label for the context check.
These are almost certainly keno proceeds (keno/lottery fits; see the Waverly lottery-fund ruling), but the page only prints 'Local'.
